title: 水平線の境界線と、風が運ぶ忘れもの
author: 群青 リク

en.title: The Horizon's Edge and the Forgotten Thing Carried by the Wind
en.premise: In a town where legend says that only on the night migratory birds return once a year does a sky‑borne ship descend to collect the town’s memories, four men and women lost in the dead‑ends of their lives go about their quiet daily routines, each shouldering regret and loss. Though they appear unrelated, an undelivered letter and a shared habit of looking up at the sky slowly draw them together. In the end, they find not a way to discard their burdens, but an answer that lets them carry them forward and keep living.

zh.title: 水平线的边界线与风带来的遗忘之物
zh.premise: 在一个传说中只有每年候鸟归来的夜晚，空中飞船才会降临收集城镇记忆的城镇里，四位陷入人生死胡同的男女各自背负着后悔与失落，静静地过着日常。表面上看似毫不相干的他们，却因一封未能送达的信和仰望天空的习惯而逐渐相连。最终，他们找到的并不是抛弃负担的办法，而是让他们带着这些负担继续生活的答案。
